prompt:

Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Edit only this object so: The largest white bird turned coral. Target near x19%, y7%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The braided dancer gained a pink hair ribbon. Target near x96%, y27%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The round ivory moon became a crescent. Target near x78%, y9%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The nearest left cottage's red roof turned blue. Target near x25%, y70%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The smallest leftmost bird disappeared. Target near x7%, y13%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.
